meta.axes: x increases east, y increases south (screen convention)
meta.joins: Where carriageways join (Jan Shoba's merge at Arcadia, Hilda into Duxbury, Jan Shoba's lane drop at Francis Baard, Duxbury at Jan Shoba where it becomes its own road to cross Lunnon and reach Lynnwood, Festival and Hilda at Burnett and Grosvenor at Arcadia, where they narrow, and Arcadia at Festival, Hilda and Grosvenor, where it changes) the corridor lists `joins`: cars reaching the end of one road drive straight onto the next. At each narrowing the kerb lane of the wider road is turn-only (Grosvenor southbound at Arcadia, Duxbury westbound at Jan Shoba as a short left-turn lane). The northbound lane of Hilda ends at Burnett because Hilda is one-way north of it. Where the Jan Shoba pair meets the divided road, the kerb lane each side tapers over 40 m (southbound a lane drop, northbound a lane gain); at Francis Baard the southbound kerb lane is left-turn only because the road drops to 3 lanes past it. The Lunnon turn roads merge into and peel off the Jan Shoba kerb lanes partway along it.
meta.layout: North to south: Stanza Bopape, Pretorius, Francis Baard, Arcadia, Park, Burnett, Prospect, South, then past Jan Shoba's 30 degree bend Duxbury, Lunnon, Lynnwood. West to east: Festival, Hilda, Grosvenor, Jan Shoba. Grosvenor, Hilda and Festival start at Stanza Bopape as T-junctions, South has a lane-wide median for 100 m either side of Jan Shoba. Duxbury's last 100 m west of Jan Shoba has a lane-wide median (eastbound: a left-turn lane and a straight-and-right lane); westbound from the 2 + 2 road east of it arrives in four lanes - left, straight, right, right. Park and Burnett carry on east of Jan Shoba as 1 + 1 two-way streets (Burnett with a lane-wide median, whose median-side lane at Jan Shoba turns right or goes straight on), and Park starts at Hilda (a T: it carries only the traffic that turns into it off Hilda, and Festival crosses no Park); Grosvenor ends at South and Festival at Prospect (T-junctions), and Hilda bends into Duxbury. South of Burnett, Festival and Hilda are 1 + 1 two-way streets, and so is Grosvenor south of Arcadia (50 km/h, an estimate). Arcadia runs from the western edge like the other streets and stops 20 m short of Jan Shoba. It changes at each of Festival, Hilda and Grosvenor: 1 + 1 two-way west of Festival, 3 lanes one-way eastbound to Hilda, where it is the eastbound approach in its own right (2 straight lanes and a right-turn lane; westbound Arcadia traffic turns south onto Hilda there), a 2 + 2 divided road with a lane-wide median to Grosvenor, then 2 + 2 undivided. Arcadia counts as a side street, not an arterial, in the results. Prospect and Lunnon do not cross Jan Shoba: each half stops short of it and their lanes curve into and out of Jan Shoba as left-turn roads (no junction; merging cars give way, about 10% of Jan Shoba traffic turns off). East of Jan Shoba Duxbury turns 45 degrees right, crosses Lunnon, bends again to meet Lynnwood square on and carries on south of it as a 1 + 1 street. Streets that start at a T carry only the traffic that turns into them. Prospect and South meet Hilda and Grosvenor at roundabouts (36 m across, no signals; drivers give way to traffic coming round from the right and drive round the island), and Prospect & Festival is a 4-way stop.
meta.source: ARTIS - Hatfield Realistic Traffic Network Reference Report (City of Tshwane Hatfield Metropolitan Node Precinct Plan for the road hierarchy and one-way system). Road existence, directionality and hierarchy are documented; lane counts, lane use and distances are ARTIS approximations.
meta.speeds: Every road 60 km/h (raised from 50 on the minor streets 2026-10-02); roundabout entry/exit slips 40 km/h.
meta.laneUse: Report section 22: kerb lane left + straight, inner lanes straight, median lane straight + right, minus any turn the junction does not offer (a one-way cross street only takes one of them). Pretorius & Jan Shoba has two left-turn lanes (report section 5). One entry per lane, kerb lane (leftmost, SA) first; a two-way street keys it by direction of travel.
meta.directions: Francis Baard and Park eastbound, Pretorius and Burnett westbound, Hilda southbound, Festival northbound. Jan Shoba north of Arcadia: the east carriageway southbound, the west one northbound (left-hand traffic), 4 lanes each north of Francis Baard and 3 south of it.
meta.demandSource: Sinusoidal fluctuation between min and max, 300 s period. Five arterials carry the network's through traffic - Stanza Bopape 3-8, Pretorius and Francis Baard 5-11, Lynnwood 3-9 and Jan Shoba 3-7 (2-5 on its one-way pair) vehicles per lane per minute - and every other street is a side street at 1-3. A simulation-demand hierarchy, not measured volumes. Saturation flow stays 1250 veh/h/lane everywhere: it is the rate the simulation's cars actually discharge from a queue (calibrated 2026-09-25), so it is the same on every road.
meta.distanceSource: Festival-Hilda-Grosvenor-Jan Shoba 245 m (the northbound Jan Shoba carriageway 245 m past Grosvenor at Francis Baard and 243 m at Pretorius and Stanza, where it is a lane wider on its kerb side, the southbound one another 245 m east; they merge 70 m south of Arcadia). North-south: Stanza-Pretorius 275 and Pretorius-Francis Baard 164 from the report; Francis Baard-Arcadia, Arcadia-Park, Park-Burnett, Burnett-Prospect and Prospect-South 250 (estimates); South to the bend 100, bend to Duxbury 300, Duxbury-Lunnon 280, Lunnon-Lynnwood 320 (estimates, reusing the report's block lengths); Duxbury east turns 140 m past Jan Shoba (estimate).

name: Hatfield Grid · realistic network
description: The Hatfield core grid from the ARTIS reference report, north to south: Stanza Bopape (two-way), Pretorius (4 lanes westbound), Francis Baard (4 lanes eastbound), Arcadia (a side street: 1 + 1 two-way west of Festival, 3 lanes one-way eastbound to Hilda, 2 + 2 divided to Grosvenor, then 2 + 2 to just short of Jan Shoba), the Park (eastbound) / Burnett (westbound) one-way pair, Prospect and South (1 + 1 two-way, Prospect meeting Jan Shoba only through left-turn roads), then Duxbury (1 + 1 west of Jan Shoba, 2 + 2 east of it), Lunnon (1 + 1, meeting Jan Shoba only through left-turn roads) and Lynnwood square to Jan Shoba where it bends 30 degrees west; east of Jan Shoba Duxbury turns south-east across Lunnon and meets Lynnwood square on, carrying on south of it as 1 + 1. West to east: Festival (one-way northbound, Prospect to Stanza), Hilda (one-way southbound from Stanza, bending into Duxbury), Grosvenor (two-way, Stanza to South) - Festival and Hilda narrow to 1 + 1 two-way south of Burnett, Grosvenor south of Arcadia - and Jan Shoba - a one-way pair (southbound east, northbound west, 4 lanes, 3 south of Francis Baard) that merges into one divided road at Arcadia. Lane counts, lane use and distances are simulation estimates, not survey data.
